reference: 1KG phase 3 EUR n=503; per-score counted allele orientation and within chromosome LD; cross-chromosome correlation zero
assumptions: beta is ALT effect; biallelic diploid reversal; p to signed normal z; same samples/effective N; source AF is ALT frequency; HWE variance; EUR reference LD matches target Z covariance
limitations: Postselected; case definitions differ; source overlap unverified; SPA and per-variant sample size/LD effects unaccounted for; reference samples may be related; FFS weights and multiallelic semantics uncertain; results are not individual-level prediction or validated score association.
